9fc732726d20a6d331eb6d2238c0e60951cd556b: A resort on a human scale, Gitschberg Jochtal focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 55 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with families or for skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Gitschberg Jochtal's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-maintained green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2510 m and a village at 1307 m, snow reliability at Gitschberg Jochtal is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause difficulties early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly once the first substantial snowfalls arrive. The budget for a stay at Gitschberg Jochtal is clearly high: 73€ for a day pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Gitschberg Jochtal keeps its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most skiers without disappointing.
